test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 12 Nov 2021 Shift 2
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Agile
solution:
The correct answer is: Lethargic

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Agile means to be quick and well-coordinated in movement.

 
 
• Example - *Monkeys are very **agile **climbers.*
 
 
 
• Marked option Lethargic means having little energy; feeling unwilling and unable to do anything.
 
 
• Example - *I was feeling tired and **lethargic**.*
 
 
 
• It is clear that 'Agile' and 'Lethargic' are opposite in meaning.

Therefore the correct answer is option 3.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Energetic means full of or needing energy and enthusiasm.
 
• Prompt means immediate; done without delay.
 
• Youthful means having or showing the freshness or energy of someone who is young.
